svg.title: System architecture
svg.desc: The proposed fire detection system sends OAK-D camera data and environmental sensor readings to Raspberry Pi and Hailo processing, then drives alerts, dashboard and event logging.
svg.text: RASPBERRY PI 5 · AI HAT+ / HAILO-8 · 26 TOPS
